title: Math.max, JSON, Number, and Map stay unconditional globals: the host rule is per-operation, not per-object
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, 'Host Globals': 'Facilities truly present in every supported JavaScript environment MAY be unconditional globals.' docs/DECISIONS.md (Locked): 'Only facilities present in every JavaScript environment may be unconditional globals.' Math.max is reached from the same Math object whose .random() is rejected by 20-host-globals/random-access-needs-a-capability, so this case is what stops an implementation from over-applying the ban to the whole object.
